rule: Read first column after header; trim surrounding whitespace; discard empty identifiers and ID sentinel; Unicode casefold; set union within molecular category. cfRNA entries contribute to their corresponding RNA categories. No cross-category merging, gene alias mapping, isoform collapsing, precursor/arm collapsing or biological entity deduplication. circRNA is audited per entry but excluded from the six-category plot; no harmonized junction catalog is asserted.
